name: @ada-mcp/mcp-server

tools.name: ada_health
tools.description: [L0-env] START ada_health(scope=web|mobile|all) once per session → L1 action → L2 recipe/batch → L3 invoke. ada://guide/routing. Runtime health: Node, Playwright, adb/WDA/hdc, plugins, dependency gaps. USE: session start, after ada_install_deps, or missing-binary errors. Not deep debug → ada_diagnostics. ARGS: scope=web|mobile|all (default web). Policy: riskApproved for invoke/launchApp/deviceAdmin; reuse sessionId; mobile: ada_devices(scan) first; on fail: recoveryHint→retry→extract→invoke.

scope.description: Which dependency families to include in the snapshot (default: web)

tools.name: ada_install_deps
tools.description: [L0-env] Install Playwright browsers, adb, WDA, hypium/hdc. USE: ada_health/diagnostics missing deps. ARGS: only=all|playwright|mobile|android|ios|harmony|drivers (default playwright); force=true.

only.description: Dependency bundle to install (default: playwright when omitted)

tools.name: ada_devices
tools.description: [L0-env] MOBILE PREREQUISITE: scan/list Android/iOS/Harmony devices. Returns rows + deviceParams.recommended + harmonyLaunchApp (Harmony launch template). Copy platform, sessionId, capabilities into ada_mobile_action (reuse sessionId). ARGS: action=scan|list (default scan). Optional deviceTags on scan.

action.description: scan (default)=run adb/hdc/xcrun and merge into registry; list=read persisted cache only

deviceTags.description: Optional tags stored with registry on scan (e.g. lab-1, team-a)

tools.name: ada_diagnostics
tools.description: [L0-env] Full doctor report (Node, registry, browsers, adb, WDA, hdc, paths, config). USE: ada_health degraded, CI setup, unexplained driver failures. Fast check → ada_health. ARGS: scope=web|mobile|all (default web).

scope.description: Limit diagnostic checks to web, mobile, or all stacks (default: web)

tools.name: ada_config
tools.description: [L0-env] Read effective agent config (yaml, env, workspace paths). USE: headless, driver dirs, risk policy before runs. No parameters.

tools.name: ada_plugins
tools.description: [L0-env] [Observe] List built-in ADA driver plugins currently registered (playwright, android, ios, harmony) with versions and capabilities. USE WHEN: verifying which engines are available before ada_web_action / ada_invoke / ada_mobile_action. No parameters required.

tools.name: ada_perf_summary
tools.description: [L0-env] MCP tool latency stats (count, avg, p50, p95, max). USE: profiling slow steps. ARGS: reset=true clears samples.

reset.description: Clear accumulated timing samples after returning summary

tools.name: ada_start_once
tools.description: [L0-env] Agent bootstrap once (credentials, deps, plugin warmup). Not UI automation → ada_web_action. ARGS: localDev=true; skipDeps=true.

localDev.description: Skip remote credential requirement for local debugging

skipDeps.description: Do not auto-run dependency install during start

tools.name: ada_web_action
tools.description: [L1-semantic] Playwright web UI step. Common: navigate, click, type, screenshot, wait, newTab. Full commands: schema.enum. ARGS: command (required), sessionId, payload (locator, url, cdpEndpoint, userDataDir, headless). Escalate: ada_web_recipe|ada_batch_actions|ada_invoke. Popups: ada_web_dismiss_popups. monitor.onFailureOnly on critical steps.
